security_audit.summary: Static matches are documentation examples, Markdown fences, placeholder URLs, and placeholder API key text. I found no evidence of executable code, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden network behavior in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Show the key as a secret-store or environment variable placeholder to reinforce safe credential handling.

remediation.issue: Several referenced auxiliary files are not included in the scanned package.
remediation.suggestion: Either include the referenced files or remove the references so users do not follow missing paths.

content.value_statement: Deployment pipelines often become risky when approvals, rollbacks, and verification are inconsistent. This skill guides multi-stage CI/CD designs with gates, strategies, metrics, and rollback patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains standard CI/CD stages from source checkout through rollback.
Compares rolling, blue-green, canary, and feature flag release strategies.
Describes manual, delayed, and multi-approver approval gate patterns.
Outlines health checks, rollback triggers, and deployment metrics.
Provides examples for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Kubernetes, and Argo Rollouts.
limitations: Does not validate environment-specific credentials, permissions, or network topology.
Provides templates and patterns; users must adapt commands before production use.
Does not include referenced auxiliary files in this package.
Does not replace security review of live deployment workflows.

use_cases.title: Design a Release Pipeline
use_cases.description: Plan stages for build, test, staging, approval, production, verification, and rollback.

use_cases.title: Add Production Gates
use_cases.description: Define approval controls for manual review, delayed deployment, or multi-approver release processes.

use_cases.title: Choose a Rollout Strategy
use_cases.description: Compare rolling, blue-green, canary, and feature flag approaches for a service release.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Basic Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner pipeline planning for one application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a simple CI/CD pipeline for [application type]. Include build, test, staging, approval, production, verification, and rollback stages.

prompt_templates.title: Add Approval Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Add production approval gates to this deployment process: [current process]. Include approvers, timing, evidence, and failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Select Deployment Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced rollout planning for a production service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare rolling, blue-green, canary, and feature flag deployment for [service]. Recommend one strategy with risks and verification checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Production Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing CI/CD workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this deployment pipeline: [pipeline summary]. Identify missing gates, weak rollback paths, monitoring gaps, and safer deployment improvements.

output_examples.input: A team wants to deploy a web API from staging to production with a manual approval step.
output: Recommended flow: build, test, deploy to staging, run smoke tests, collect approval, deploy production, verify health, and prepare rollback.
Approval evidence should include test results, deployment diff, monitoring status, and rollback owner.

output_examples.input: A service needs lower-risk production releases for frequent changes.
output: Use canary delivery when traffic routing and monitoring are available.
Start with a small traffic percentage, pause for metrics, expand gradually, and stop on error-rate regression.

output_examples.input: A team needs rollback guidance for Kubernetes deployments.
output: Define automated health checks after rollout and set clear failure thresholds.
Keep manual rollback instructions available for operators when automated rollback cannot determine impact.

best_practices: Run fast tests early and reserve slower verification for later pipeline stages.
Use explicit approval evidence before production deployment.
Pair every deployment strategy with monitoring, rollback ownership, and documented recovery steps.
anti_patterns: Skipping staging verification before production approval.
Using deployment commands without adapting them to environment permissions and secrets.
Adding manual approval without defining evidence, timeout behavior, or rollback criteria.

faq.question: Does this skill run deployments?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance and examples for users to adapt in their own CI/CD systems.

faq.question: Which CI systems are covered?
faq.answer: The skill includes examples for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Kubernetes, and Argo Rollouts.

faq.question: Does it manage secrets?
faq.answer: No. It recommends safe secret handling, but users must configure their own secret stores and access controls.

faq.question: Can it help with rollback planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers automated rollback checks, manual rollback steps, and deployment verification metrics.

faq.question: Is the output production ready?
faq.answer: No. The patterns require environment-specific validation, security review, and testing before production use.

faq.question: Are the referenced files included?
faq.answer: No. The scanned package only includes SKILL.md, so referenced auxiliary files are not available.
